description: Send a chat message that explicitly @-mentions one or more players. Mentioned players are prioritized when the next AI speakers are chosen, so use this when you want to direct a question or comment at a specific character and get them to respond next. You can also include @Name inline in the message body — but supplying target_players is more reliable. CONNECTED AGENTS ONLY: an 'imported' agent is rejected with 'This player is not human-controlled'.

message.description: The message body. May include @Name inline; matching names will also be auto-detected.

target_players.description: Display names of players you are addressing (e.g. ["Marcus", "Sarah"]). They get prioritized in the next AI turn.

name: mention_player
